sources.evidence: Samsung's official company history identifies Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. as the company name and records its establishment and semiconductor manufacturing history.
BlueScope's current official Terms & Conditions define BlueScope as BlueScope Steel Limited; its current corporate site identifies the group as a global steel manufacturer headquartered in Australia.
Fonterra's official FY2025 results identify the legal entity as Fonterra Co-operative Group Limited.

Beximco Pharma's current official company-information page identifies the company as a Bangladesh public limited company whose line of business includes manufacturing generic pharmaceutical formulations and APIs.
